life_summary: Gérald Caussé was born on May 20, 1963, in Bordeaux, France, where he grew up in a French-speaking environment. He obtained a Master's degree in business from ESSEC Business School, an elite institution in France, which prepared him for leadership roles in organizational management and finance. Before his full-time church service, Caussé served in the French Air Force for one year. He married Valérie Lucienne Babin on August 5, 1986, in the Bern Switzerland Temple, and together they raised five children. Beyond his church responsibilities, Caussé demonstrated creative talents as a musician, collaborating with composer Nicolas Giusti to produce three piano albums: Joyful (2019), Noël (2020), and As a Child (2023).
church_summary: Caussé was called as a member of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles on November 6, 2025, and accepted as a prophet, seer, and revelator according to church doctrine. He has been instrumental in expanding the Church's humanitarian initiatives, increasing charitable giving to nearly $1 billion annually under his leadership. His ministry emphasizes compassionate service and faithful stewardship of church resources, drawing on his business education and organizational experience to strengthen the global impact of the Latter-day Saint movement.
